score_objections.objection: None of the cited sources address regulating tech companies or Big Tech. The REAL Act only imposes disclosure duties on federal agencies and officials, and the fraud hearing targets government ID verification. There is no evidence here for any tech_regulation position, so -1 'Targeted rules' rests on nothing in the record.
